decisions.reason: Removing Aave necessarily invalidates the About-page technology and feature copy that says Aave enables prize-pool yield.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Cool.
I can release the payment for phase 2 today, although we’ll still need to update the FAQs and then handle Transak in a couple days.
We’ll also still need to conduct thorough testing (no referral code tests, block pool prize trigger tests, fiat payment tests, email link, etc.), and I’ll need to upload the ebook PDF and test all of that as well.
There are also a lot of wording adjustments to make across the site.
Is that okay?

I’d also like to add or revise the hero section on home (above the fold) using copy and a layout along these lines.

Hero Headline: From dropout multimillionaire to zero in a flash. Rebuilding now — rewarding affiliates and creating a network to free creators from Amazon KDP's 70% cut.

Sub-Headline: "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal" — Unlimited NFT book ⋅ $15 forever ⋅ Base.
Mechanics Tease: Buy → own the book and receive your referral link. Refer → earn instant & unlimited $5 plus prize draw tickets.
CTA Button: Mint for $15
The book cover should also be integrated into the landing page.

decisions.reason: The Aave removal does not change the Big Block prize amount, draw trigger, ticket rules, or non-yield pool-funding semantics.
Removing prize-pool yield does not determine whether prizes are automatically transferred or claimed through the Winners page.
The Small Block draw parameters and sales-funded pool remain valid without the separate Aave yield integration.
The source removes yield generation but does not alter the per-sale allocations or the destination of the prize-pool allocation.
Secondary royalties can continue funding prize pools without those deposits generating Aave yield; no current royalty attribute requires modification.
The Transak fiat-mint provider and conversion flow are independent of the removed Aave prize-pool integration.
The hero content introduced by the same message mentions referral commissions and prize tickets but makes no Aave or yield claim.
Fiat-buyer wallet provisioning and access to commissions, tickets, and prizes do not depend on Aave yield generation.
The automatic $5 coded-referral commission remains unchanged by removal of prize-pool yield generation.
Brevo transactional email transport is unrelated to the Aave prize-pool integration.
The NFT mint number's referral-code identity and display locations remain valid without Aave yield generation.
